run_linear_assignment: run linear assignment on a cost matrix with a threshold to get matched and unmatched indices
build_iou_distance_matrix: build an IoU-based distance cost matrix between two sets of tracks or bounding boxes
fuse_detection_scores: fuse detection scores into a cost matrix by multiplying IoU similarity with detection confidence
test_indices_to_matches: test indices_to_matches to filter matched pairs from a cost matrix using a threshold
review_linear_assignment: review linear_assignment to understand how scipy's linear_sum_assignment is used with threshold filtering
